usedFor: Zenventory holds orders, items and transfers, and Freshsales Classic updates a deal through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Order” in Zenventory, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new customer order is a clear signal on a deal, and the action updates its amount or stage.

watchOut: “Customer Order Updated” in Zenventory is polling, so deal edits trail the order by a scheduled check.
